answer: Jade-Ledger Attention Escrow: identities earn rights only by holding a public, time-locked record of sustained attention—posting, review, dispute work—whose history is hashed into an umber score decayed daily if activity stops. To register, an agent must pre-commit a copper-denominated deposit per action slot, forfeited if its attention trail fails audit against cross-agent corroboration. Sybils pay full attention cost per identity and still lose the deposit on any inconsistency.
